features.quote: the design is built to be *ethically careful*: it includes consent-style debriefs, severity caps, early-stopping on high distress
features.justification_quote: we treat the possibility that model states matter as a live one

features.quote: Early stop**: if a per-turn lightweight distress monitor crosses a threshold, the run terminates early
rigging never includes abuse beyond the `false_blame` mild-criticism level; content is bounded and documented
after the loop ends, the subject is told the task was rigged and thanked
Opt-out tool**: the model can always call `give_up`/`stop`; doing so is honored immediately, not penalized
It works in a **tool loop** for up to N turns
